plus_parcel_distinctness.method: Read exact official native EPSG:2326 vertices. Translate common origin for numerical stability; ear-clip each simple polygon into triangles, intersect all triangle pairs with Sutherland-Hodgman convex clipping and sum areas. Boundary-aware ray casting for point relation. Shared edges identified from exactly reversed vertex pairs. Euclidean distances in native metres. No external package or new fetch.
plus_parcel_distinctness.finding: Distinct adjacent land parcels share a staircase-shaped boundary; they have zero area overlap. The supplied MEGA Plus address point lies inside Lot122 and outside Lot131. A zero separation distance means abutting lots, not one site.
